Draft EM postulate is the relativistic prescribed-external-field coupling for a constant-charge, positive-rest-mass timelike test particle; it explicitly declines to adopt the nonrelativistic coordinate force law as exact. Not used to derive minimal, Pauli, or dipole quantum coupling.

Draft EM theorem is limited to coherent same-frequency ideal plane-wave solutions of the smooth source-free vacuum Maxwell branch and excludes detector/sampling statistics. Its declared mathematical premise lem-em-period-average is draft/domain mathematics, so the theorem is not imported; the scaffold proves its simpler Jones-amplitude comparison locally under an explicit analyzer model.

Draft EM definition is framework-local SI bookkeeping and expressly makes no cross-framework identification. The scaffold states its SI constants as unit conventions and does not use this EM item as a QM physical premise.
